name: White Bean-Chicken Chili with Bell Pepper, Corn & Tortilla Strips

instructions.primary_message: Slice tortillas in half, then crosswise into ½-inch strips. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; toss to coat and spread out in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 small corn tortillas
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until tortilla strips are golden and crispy, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 sticks celery
3 red bell peppers
3 medium zucchini squash
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Trim and medium dice celery. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the celery.
Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, chicken, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
0.68 kg ground chicken
2 tbsp chili powder
¾ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse beans. Set aside to drain further.
When the chicken is done, add veggies, corn, and flour to the pot. Stir to combine and continue to cook until veggies are tender, 4-5 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup frozen corn
2 tbsp all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.

When the veggies are done, add beans and broth to the pot; stir to combine the chili and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until beans are tender and chili thickens slightly, 10-12 minutes.
When the chili is done, juice limes into the pot. Add cilantro and yogurt, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide chili between bowls and top with crispy tortilla strips. Enjoy!
